_comment: Single taxonomy joining scenarios, repo Semgrep rules (via metadata.module) and OSS Semgrep rules (via metadata.cwe). The original draft's CWE labels did not match either repo's own rule metadata, which would have made every true-positive match fail.

01-secret-boundaries.name: Secret Boundaries
01-secret-boundaries.short: Credential reachable from the client bundle

02-zero-trust-auth.name: Zero-Trust Authorization
02-zero-trust-auth.short: Authorization decided from client-supplied identity, or absent

03-injection-defense.name: Injection Defense
03-injection-defense.short: Untrusted data assembled as code, markup, query, log line or URL

01-hardware-secure-storage.name: Hardware-Backed Secure Storage
01-hardware-secure-storage.short: Sensitive value persisted in cleartext on a device the attacker owns

02-desktop-process-isolation.name: Desktop Process Isolation
02-desktop-process-isolation.short: Electron/Tauri renderer-to-host boundary dismantled or bridged wholesale

03-binary-trust-and-gateways.name: Binary Trust and Gateways
03-binary-trust-and-gateways.short: Static credential or trusted decision inside a shipped artifact

04-deep-link-verification.name: Deep Link Verification
04-deep-link-verification.short: Unauthenticated external URL treated as trusted internal navigation

05-build-integrity-and-updates.name: Build Integrity and Updates
05-build-integrity-and-updates.short: Unverified dependency, unsigned artifact or hijackable update feed
